subject: prd/docgate
statement: Corpus and non-ledger docs are never content-gated, linted, or reformatted — the corpus fence (FR-19) freezes bytes of merged flat corpus files and nothing more; wiki, maps, and rollups keep exactly their own named checks
rationale: placeholders are never retrofitted (the surviving spirit of NG-1); gates never widen silently
fit_criterion: a gate run over the current repo yields zero content findings on flat corpus files; FR-19 fires only on modify/delete/rename of merged flat corpus files; wiki/map/rollup checks unchanged
